machine.name: Carvera Air — nominal envelopes from Makera simplified CAD
machine.notes: Extracted from Z component of official simplified STEP on 2026-11-11. Cylinders are exact CAD radii; motor and Z plate use conservative bounding boxes. This is not metrology-grade CAD. Confirm actual nose, collar, accessories, stickout, orientation and operating offsets before setting verified=true. Does not model the X gantry, probe, dust shoe, hoses, wiring or machine frame.
machine.coordinate_derivation: CAD local spindle center x=-74.0385852576533, z=28.999999999998; lower nose y=201.458967162417. Simulator X=CAD x+74.0385852576533, Y=29-CAD z, Z=CAD y-201.458967162417. Gauge is lower nose face, tip+stickout.

limits: 100 um is voxel pitch, not a physical machining-accuracy guarantee
Sub-voxel features and clearances may be unresolved; set a finer pitch or collision margin
Motion is nominal; no deflection, runout, backlash, acceleration, corner blending or material forces

metrics.removal_definition: Actual removed voxel volume divided by each interval duration, multiplied by 60; interval mean, mm^3/min
metrics.approach_definition: Maximum positive velocity component toward a voxel face within 20 mm of the rotating cutter envelope; centre-sampled transverse projection and half-cell axial face correction; maximum of interval start/mid/end probes against stock before that interval is cut
metrics.approach_scope: Remaining stock only, cutter envelope only; excludes fixtures and holder/head (checked separately for collisions); voxel-face normals, not fitted smooth-surface normals
metrics.sampling_note: Diagnostic samples, not an exact continuous peak bound; short transients can require smaller sample period/travel
metrics.zero_duration_note: A zero-duration interval that removes material has NaN rate; removed_mm3 is retained
